about_the_game:
Step into the pulse of Full Effect with its original soundtrack — a high-energy blend of neurofunk, breakbeat, and heavy riffs designed to keep you on edge through every firefight and tactical decision.

This isn’t just background music; it’s a dynamic audio arsenal built to amplify the chaos, danger, and momentum of the battlefield.
